title: gournal log

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:gen. Do not edit. Edit examples in site/src/content/examples/cli/log.md. -->

Show your entries in time order, grouped by day. The log covers today unless you choose a period.

## Usage

    gournal log [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-y, --yesterday` | Show yesterday and today. |  |
| `-w, --week` | Show the current week. |  |
| `-m, --month` | Show the current month. |  |
| `--from <date>` | Start of the period (inclusive). Use a local day or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `--to <date>` | End of the period (inclusive). Use a local day or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `-p, --project <project>` | Show only entries of this project. |  |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Show only entries of this repository. |  |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Show only entries with all of these tags. Separate tags with commas. |  |

## Examples

Show every entry of today in time order, with the project and tags of each entry.

```console
$ gournal log

Work Log: Today (2026-11-15)

  Sun Nov 15
    16:04 53X22ZXF  Fix rounding error in invoice totals  [billing-api] #bugfix #invoices
    16:04 0MC5VPCQ  Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging  [billing-api] #webhooks
    16:04 V91XZBEK  Add a regression test for tax rounding  [billing-api] #testing #invoices
    16:04 TR4Q5EFK  Move the settings page to the new form components  [web-app] #ui
    16:04 4C537GWA  Add keyboard focus styles to the date picker  [web-app] #ui #a11y

  5 entries across 2 projects.
```
